resources.string: Your private family vault is locked.
Your device\'s fingerprints changed, so fingerprint unlock was switched off for safety. Your vault is untouched. Unlock with your master passphrase, then turn fingerprint unlock on again in Settings.
Enter the recovery key from your Emergency Recovery Kit and choose a new master passphrase.
Confirm your fingerprint to open the vault
Confirm your fingerprint to protect the vault key
This item is marked High Security
A calm, private place for your family\'s most important logins, cards and documents.
Your vault stays on your device
Romba Mukiyam does not upload your passwords. There is no account, no cloud and no internet permission.
Everything is stored in an encrypted database that only your master passphrase (or your fingerprint) can open.
Your master passphrase is never stored in readable form.
You decide when to create an encrypted backup file and where to keep it.
If you lose your master passphrase AND your recovery key, nobody can open the vault — not even us. There is no back door.
A long sentence you can remember works best, for example three or four unrelated words. You will need it whenever fingerprint unlock is unavailable.
This makes sure there is no typing mistake in your master passphrase.
Generating keys and preparing encryption for this device. This can take a few seconds.
If you ever forget the master passphrase, this key is the only other way in. Write it down and keep it somewhere physically safe — for example with important family papers.
Romba Mukiyam cannot show this key again later. You can generate a new one from Settings, but only while you can still unlock the vault.
I have written down my recovery key and stored it safely.
For everyday use, your fingerprint opens the vault quickly. Your master passphrase always remains the fallback.
This device has no enrolled fingerprint. You can enable fingerprint unlock later from Settings after adding one in your phone settings.
Create the first family profile. You can add Mom, Dad, siblings and joint accounts later.
Backups are encrypted files you save to a USB drive, SD card or computer. How often should Romba Mukiyam remind you?
Mix letters, numbers or symbols — or use several words.
The vault is locked. Please unlock it first.
Romba Mukiyam could not open the vault right now. Your existing information is safe.
The vault database reported a problem. Nothing has been changed. Please create a backup and see Vault Health.
Romba Mukiyam could not save this change because the device has insufficient storage. Your existing vault data is safe.
The backup could not be completed. Your vault has not been changed.
This file is not a Romba Mukiyam backup.
This backup format is not supported by this version.
This backup was made by a newer version of Romba Mukiyam. Please update the app first.
This backup file is damaged or incomplete and was rejected. Your current vault is unchanged.
The passphrase for this backup is not correct.
The recovery key is not correct. Check every character and try again.
The vault could not be upgraded. Your existing data has been preserved untouched. Please create a backup from Safe Mode.
Fingerprint unlock needs to be set up again. Please use your master passphrase.
No fingerprint is enrolled on this device.
This device has no fingerprint sensor.
Fingerprint is not available right now. Use your master passphrase.
A required permission is not available.
Something went wrong. Your existing information remains safe.
Safe Mode: only viewing, backup and restore are available.
This device appears to have reduced platform security (it may be rooted). Romba Mukiyam will still work, but a compromised device can expose secrets while the vault is open.
